# Rulings register

A **ruling** settles a point where the 1979 rules (after errata) are unclear or
contradict themselves; the rules pages already show the result. A **variant** is a
community change we record but do not adopt. Each entry lists its status and the SPI
cases it touches; [how rulings work](./README.md) explains how to propose or dispute one.
